'''Jhonus Raam''' was a [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] brand. In [[45 ABY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Barduun]] wore a Jhonus Raam [[Color/Legends|brown]]-colored padded bodysuit, of a variety typically worn beneath a [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|beskar'gam]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] set while serving the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] businessmen [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] at the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Base Prime]]. The bodysuit had the Jhonus Raam brand name stencilled on its chest. Barduun was rendered insane from passing through the [[space–time-warping gate]] of a [[Unidentified monolith|monolith]] under study by the Qreph brothers and the Mandalorian took to referring to himself in the third person as "Jhonus Raam."<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
The brand name Jhonus Raam appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
